picks.why: Onto trades at 19x forward earnings with +35% revenue growth and a 23% operating margin, 42% below its high, and SK Hynix's shortage warning puts its memory-linked inspection business back in focus. It ties to the memory shortage thesis without paying the neocloud or hyperscaler spending risk.
picks.risk: Lighter hyperscaler capex or a Samsung-style profit miss could push out memory tool orders, and the stock is still 14% below its 200-day average.

picks.why: Broadcom has +86% revenue growth and a 54% operating margin at 18x forward earnings, 29% off its high, which is real cash flow at a price that limits downside. Custom AI silicon is the beneficiary if buyers shift away from Nvidia while spending stays high.
picks.risk: Broadcom fell with INTC, AMD and MU on lighter Microsoft and Alphabet capex, so it is directly exposed to hyperscaler spending cuts.

passed_on.reason: Revenue -11% and a negative operating margin do not fit the quality bar despite the grid theme.
Already 51% above its 200-day average, so there is little margin of safety.
